notes.title: Storyline Hints. Devlog #3
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hi Peeps![/b][/h2]

[u]We know how eager you are to know more about Nobody's Left and we can't wait either, but let's take one step at a time.[/u]

We have no intention of sharing the games storyline in details before it's release but in appreciation to your support we can indeed share some hints about what you will likely get to experience on our release date.

The storyline of Nobody's Left has been worked on for more than 3 years and reviewed and polished several times, it does indeed have realistic roots in it that many can resonate to. it covers circumstances that would destroy the capability of any human being to mentally function. we as the development team are very emotional about the story of Nobody's Left and we designed every bit of the game to transfer this feeling to ones that get to experience it. we did our best to make sure that it does not come across as boring or liner but instead engaging in a unique way like never before. it includes relations with one another and environments that surrounds them and their interactions in a post apocalyptic city where human beings tend to not obey their traditional mental models. it's through the incidents that the player gets to learn more about the game world and attention to details of each environment plays a big role in how much you can learn about the past and future of those incidents. 

have us followed and we promise to share more in the future. 
You can also ask us in the comments section, We will answer with more hints ;)


As always, Please show us some love by wishlisting Nobody's Left!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2370280/Nobodys_Left/]WISHLIST[/url]



all the best,
Ario Asgarian
Business Director and Project manager

notes.title: IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44091424/7d82a85ab082a7362cf730b90b8af69a82c1eace.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44091424/74f06993a795164e89a2cd7d34cd707eefc06ce6.png[/img][/url]


[b]Important announcement[/b]

Dear fans and followers,

The growing community and growing support from our amazing followers has led to scammers and hackers targeting our game and mission more than ever before. we receive reports on daily basis about such cases and we are following the cases with authorities to find the people behind these acts.

meanwhile please keep the following points in mind:

1. We still have not opened an official discord channel and all links inviting you to such channels are fake and you should not click on them.

2. Madrain.studio and Nobodysleft.com are currently controlled by hackers and we have no active website at the moment, our only official ways of communication are currently our official steam page and our Instagram page @nobodys.left

3. do not click on any links sent to you on our behalf by email or anywhere else.

4. we will never ask for your personal or bank information.

5. we will never ask for you to pay or purchase anything unless earlier informed on our official steam page.

Stay safe and watch out for scammers that abuse our name and reputation.

notes.title: We're finally here!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Dear fans and followers,[/b][/h3]

The long wait is over! we are happy to announce that Nobody's left official Steam page is now publicly accessible, and we would like to thank each and every supporter that gifted our dream a reality. <3 
What you see is the result of years of hard work put into this project and we are happy to be one step closer to delivering it to you! 
based on how much we know our fans, we are focused on making this game a unique experience unlike anything you have tried before😉, and we have exciting news for you soon. from now on I promise to keep you updated on the process continuedly. So please show your love and support by adding "Nobody's left" to your Wishlist.

Let's get it together!
Head of Business Development - Ario Asgarian
